The '''LCK 2016 Summer''' was the second split of the 2016 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games in partnership with OnGameNet and SPOTV GAMES. Officially titled the '''Coca-Cola Zero LCK 2016 Summer''' for sponsorship reasons, the competition took place in Seoul, South Korea, from May 25 to August 20, 2016, featuring ten teams.

The regular season was played in a Double Round Robin format with Best-of-Three matches, while the Playoffs followed a Single Elimination King of the Hill format with Best-of-Five series. Teams competed for a ₩275,000,000 KRW prize pool, with the split champion qualifying for the [[World Championship/2016|2016 World Championship]]. [[ESC Ever]] and [[MVP]] joined the league through the [[LCK/2016/Summer/Promotion|2016 Summer Promotion Tournament]]. Matches were played primarily on Patches 6.10 through 6.15.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th and 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 8th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/Spring/Spring|Spring split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2017/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]].
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** Wild Card match is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
*** Round 1 onwards is {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
* Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2016|World Championship 2016]]
